address: IAD37 Data Center | 44060 Digital Loudoun Plaza Bldg K | Digital Realty
44060 Digital Loudoun Plaza (Bldg K), Ashburn, VA 20147

reading.body:
IAD37 publishes 500 MW of IT capacity, making it the largest single campus by published IT load among Virginia's tracked facilities and representing 38 percent of the 1,326 MW across the 19 facilities with disclosed figures.

The 500 MW figure translates to between 12,500 racks at AI training density of 40 kW per rack, or 50,000 racks at legacy enterprise density of 10 kW per rack. This wide range reflects the absence of any published rack count or per-rack power envelope from Digital Reality on the spec page. Digital Realty has disclosed only the aggregate IT capacity, not the workload composition or density that would pin down how many accelerator slots the facility actually contains.

The campus holds three certifications: PCI DSS for payment card workloads, ISO 27001 for information security management, and ISO 9001 for quality processes. These certifications qualify the facility to host certain categories of work, but do not reveal which tenants occupy it, what fraction of the 500 MW is currently committed versus available for allocation, or whether any capacity is reserved for AI workloads specifically. Virginia has 326 mapped facilities in total, of which only 19 publish capacity figures, so the state's actual installed base and its allocation across use cases remain substantially opaque.
